purpose: The 4-row dry run section 6.6 of docs/readiness/2026-09-06-e22-dev-usage-cells-v1-preregistration.md requires before cell (a) flies, on four rows of the same 1,500-row roster chosen before any contact to bracket it (longest, shortest, median, p90 by duration). Four reads, in order of importance: (1) does --n-cpu-moe 28 at -c 40960 -np 8 actually leave at least 3,072 MiB free on the card, and how close is the achieved figure to the 5,083 MiB the offline placement receipt projected; (2) does a LIVE mmproj encode of the 32.88 s worst case complete without an out-of-memory or CUDA fault -- the exact condition the A2T probe never tested, because every one of its 400 rows was a feature-cache hit; (3) what is the measured Q8_0-to-Q4_K_M per-call latency ratio against the 7.85x the flight budget assumes; (4) do both ESB scorers score the sealed manifest through core.scoring_batch with verified = true. The smoke's own WER numbers are on four rows and enter no verdict.

E22-ESB-DEV1500-SMOKE-4.selection: deterministic and pre-registered, the same rule the 2026-09-05 dev smoke used: the longest utterance (the encode and VRAM worst case), the shortest, the median and the p90 by duration over the drawn 1,500, ties broken by sample id

cells.serving_geometry: -c 40960 -np 8, 5120 tokens per slot, --n-cpu-moe 28 -- identical to the flight
cells.factor: none; this is cell (a)'s own protocol on four rows

shared_protocol.audio_path: raw audio, bf16 mmproj resident on the GPU, no feature cache directory
shared_protocol.obs: none -- an ESB utterance IS the request

evaluation.paper_facing_aggregation: corpus: total S+D+I over total reference words
metrics: achieved free VRAM after load at --n-cpu-moe 28, against the 3,072 MiB floor and the 5,083 MiB projection
llama.cpp's own printed audio-encoder compute-buffer estimate at this geometry, against the achieved free
server RSS and host available memory, against the A2T ladder's 18,533 / 54,633 MiB at N = 28
per-call latency, and the ratio to the sealed Q4_K_M comparator's 1.927 s mean
prompt_tokens per request (the text envelope) and completion tokens
whether both ESB scorers returned per-sample rows through core.scoring_batch with verified = true

execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: 4 rows x 1 contact = 4, plus headroom for a canary and one recovery attempt; the registered ceiling is 60. core/model/adapter.py meters the plan cumulatively across every attempt of this run id.
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 51.7005 s for one pass, rounded up to 120 to cover a recovery attempt; the registered ceiling is 200.
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: 0.5, twice the Q4_K_M smoke's, because a 30.3 GiB Q8_0 load with 28 layers of experts faulting into host RAM is the dominant cost of a four-row pass; the registered ceiling is 1.0.

decision.go_no_go: The flight launches only if all four reads are affirmative: the achieved free VRAM at N = 28 is at or above 3,072 MiB AND at or above llama.cpp's own printed encoder estimate; the 32.88 s live encode completes with no CUDA fault or out-of-memory; both ESB scorers return per-sample rows on the sealed manifest through core.scoring_batch with verified = true; and the projected flight time at the measured latency is at or under the registered 3.0 GPU-hour ceiling. If the achieved free is below the floor, the cell STOPS -- it does not shrink -np, and a geometry change is a new registration.
decision.claim_surface: none; a smoke's numbers enter no verdict
